head: Kohl's on Uber Eats: delivery from 1,100 stores and $10 off
dek: Since 17 November you can order from more than 1,100 Kohl's stores across the US on Uber Eats: clothes, shoes, home goods, gifts and Sephora at Kohl's beauty products, delivered right away or at a time you pick.
details: A first Kohl's order of $50 or more on Uber Eats gets $10 off until 3 December. Orders can be tracked in the Uber Eats app. The report doesn't mention Uber One benefits.
where: US, Uber Eats app, more than 1,100 Kohl's stores, from 17 November
means: If you need a last-minute gift or outfit, Kohl's can now come to your door through Uber Eats like a food order.
todo: Open Uber Eats, search for Kohl's or look in the Retail section, pick a store, add items and choose a delivery time. Spend $50 or more on your first Kohl's order before 3 December for the $10 off.
